verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਸੁਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee kulaa dharam karam kai suchaar chaar soiee paravaar bikhai sresaT bakhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: He who performs all deeds according to his family traditions, behaves well and kindly is known as an ideal person in the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਨਜੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਹ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਬਨਉਟਾ ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: banaj biauhaar saacho saeh sanamukh sadhaa soiee tau banauTaa nihakapaT kai maaneeaai ||

en.bdb: He who is honest of all his dealings, alone is considered guileless and sincere before his master, the rich merchant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮਿ ਕਾਮ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਨਰੇਸ ਆਨ ਸੋਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਮ ਕਾਰਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: suaam kaam saavadhaan maanat nares aan soiee savaiaam kaarajee prasidh pahichaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: He who acknowledges the authority of his king and performs his master's tasks with care and devotion is always recognised as the ideal servant of the master (king).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਖ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੮੦॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes paraves ridh a(n)tar hai sabadh surat soiee sikh jag jaaneeaai ||380||

en.bdb: Similarly, an obedient Sikh of the Guru who lodges the teachings of True Guru in his mind and engrosses his consciousness in the divine word is known the world over.  (380)
